title: Craft Blend 2-Mix Duo #21 (동심원 3구역·매끈 / 세로 띠 3구역·물결)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Chinese woman in her early 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair matte skin with a soft powdery finish, thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge, a poised, glamorous expression, demure and soft, deep dark brown hair styled in twin-tail, real living eyes. Long square nails, glossy finish.

Left woman's physique: An enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 3 regions of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 42% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 2 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 43% and 61% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it is painted in Ethiopian cross-and-lattice gold pattern (a deep wine-red ground with fine gold lattice linework), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with lattice linework filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems), wide cobalt-and-coral bands following the contours of the body, with floral scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: both hands sweeping her hair back, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Left woman's footwear: extreme platform lace-up sandals, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Hawaiian woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a natural glowing complexion, a flower tucked behind one ear, warm golden-tan skin, cheerful, cool ash-brown hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, holographic finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 3 regions of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 vertical bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 35% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 58% of the way across her figure from her left edge. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it is painted in Korean eunipsa silver inlay (a deep black ground with thick bright silver linework), wide bold silver bands following the contours of the body, with lattice fills filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Thai Benjarong porcelain (a black ground with five-colour jewel enamels in lotus-petal motifs), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with tiered lotus-petal work filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: full side profile, one arm reaching forward, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Center woman's footwear: platform stiletto knee-high boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 8K.
